scope: Proposition 5.2 (Transport of evaluation and contraction) of the manuscript “Weil classes and Hodge classes on abelian powers” (preprints/Weil-classes-and-Hodge-classes-on-abelian-powers-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 032 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c035db86eb706573), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 45-46. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the fixed enhanced Fourier–Mukai equivalence Φ : Perf(A) → Perf(B), there exists an isomorphism ΦH HH : HΩ−2(A) ∼ − → HΩ−2(B) depending only on that enhanced equivalence, not on a choice of perfect complex, such that for every Q ∈ Perf(A), ΦExt ◦ obQ = obΦQ ◦ΦHT , ΦH HH ◦ cQ = cΦQ ◦ ΦHT . (5.27) 45 Here ob and c have the conventions of Proposition 5.1, and ΦExt is the induced enhanced map on degree-two Ext. Consequently ΦHT (ker obQ) = ker obΦQ, ΦHT (ker cQ) = ker cΦQ. (5.28) In particular ker obQ = ker cQ implies ker obΦQ = ker cΦQ.
